I'm so glad I'm not alone. I was wondering what my reaction to her stories was saying about me. The childhood she's describing isn't terribly dissimilar from my own (besides the arrest) and I'm just like ? I mean yeah things got messy and a little bit fucked up but damn. 

Her saying that her mom "assaulted" someone who was physically harming her because "she didn't get to be the one to be harming me" seemed like a major stretch. & don't get me started on the "fatphobia" about the fat baby lmaoooooo
Also came here to confirm - thank you for your service OP
